thread:
alex: kicking off a small canary for structured output / function-calling support. plan: enable flag `so_function_calling` for 5% of hosted API traffic and all dedicated dev teams in staging. checking compatibility with SDKs. pinging @maria and @sam for client SDK behavior notes.

maria: sounds good. are we doing `compat_mode=legacy` or `compat_mode=strict` by default? strict will break older clients.

sam: +1 on strict in canary only. we should set `so_compat: best_effort` for mobile SDKs. mobile client's v1.2 doesn't handle tool-calling fields.

alex: ok i'll set rules: hosted: 5% traffic (random), staging: 100% in beta orgs, dedicated: off unless requested. config snippet:
```
flags:
  so_function_calling: enabled
  so_compat_mode: canary_strict
canary:
  percent: 5
  audiences:
    - beta-orgs
    - internal-devs
```

jon: canary-bot reported a failing schema on tensorflow-service yesterday, stack trace in #incidents. we should add a fallback to text-only when schema validation fails.

dena: agree. fallback policy: if schema validation error -> response falls back to plain text and log event with label `so_schema_fail`. also emit metric `so.fallback.rate`.

maria: quick Q: do we need a client opt-in flag in mobile SDK too? if so, we'll need a tiny release.

sam: yes, add `client_sdk.consider_structured_output` default false for versions <1.3. we can ship a patch to 1.3 with default true.

alex: action items: (1) alex - update rollout config and push feature flag change (2) maria - prepare mobile SDK patch PR (target: end of week) (3) sam - add canary dashboards and metric alerts (4) dena - implement fallback logging + metric. tagging @canary-bot to start canary at 18:10 UTC.

canary-bot: scheduled canary start at 18:10 UTC. monitoring window 60m. will post results.

maria: noted, i'll draft PR and ping for review.

jon: FYI i'll open a postmortem template in #postmortems in case we need it.

alex: thanks all. if anyone sees regressions during the canary ping here and tag me. :thumbsup:
